content.comment_body: Hello, I've connected my [product_name] to the cloud for managing a carlift. The device is only powered on for about 20 minutes daily. After each shutdown, I have to manually re-enter the gateway to restore cloud connectivity, since it doesn't retain the gateway setting. The IP address is saved correctly and remains in memory. Is there a way to make the device remember the gateway setting as well?

Hello, You can set the gateway in the IP settings of your [product_name]. If you have a model with a display, you can configure it directly through the device's IP settings. Alternatively, you can use [product_name] Soft Comfort, which is easiest when working on a network project by selecting the IP settings in "Online" mode. Once this is configured, the default gateway should stay stored until you change it or perform a device reset. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report that the gateway configuration on [product_name] does not persist after the device is turned off, requiring manual re-entry whenever the power is cycled. The IP address remains saved, but the instability of the gateway setting interferes with the device's ability to auto-connect to the cloud, especially in scenarios with frequent power cycling such as carlift operation. This raises concerns about configuration reliability for remote automation involving networking.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that the gateway IP configuration will remain saved even after power cycles, just as the device's IP address does.
